FR-GEN-001.fault_retry: JobService.retry transitions the existing Job to QUEUED; the next worker claim creates attempt_no + 1 and does not create a Variant or replace a take.
FR-GEN-001.creative_reroll: GenerationService.derive_variant_plan plus submit_confirmed_variant creates a child GenerationVariant and an independent Job.
FR-GEN-001.ui_entry: JobsPanel labels the operation as 故障重试（同一 Job） and routes GENERATION_VARIANT creative rerolls to Variant Composer.

FR-GEN-002.same_input_scope: RESAMPLE_NEW_SEED preserves prompt revision, profile version, parameter set and media bindings; only explicit_seed (and semantic SEED when declared) changes.
FR-GEN-002.provider_random_scope: RESUBMIT_PROVIDER_RANDOM freezes a new UUID nonce and reports NON_REPRODUCIBLE when the Profile allows provider random.
FR-GEN-002.ui_entry: GenerationWorkbench exposes same-image/same-prompt seed batch, new seed, fixed-seed exact replay, and Provider random actions with a reproducibility note.

FR-GEN-003.snapshot: Submitted Jobs now freeze profile revision, runtime version, workflow version/content hash, local model bundle/hash and manifest hash in input_snapshot.execution_snapshot.
FR-GEN-003.replay_scope: EXACT_REPLAY rejects seed/input/parameter overrides and reports an empty changed_fields diff; it does not claim pixel identity for non-deterministic runtimes.

FR-GEN-004.scope: PROMPT_BRANCH changes only prompt_revision_id; source bindings, Profile, parameters and seed remain preserved.
FR-GEN-004.lineage: Child Variant stores parent_variant_id and lineage endpoint returns parent-to-child order.
FR-GEN-004.diff: Derivation plan returns changed_fields, before, after and preserved_fields before any Variant or Job is persisted.

verification.note: The focused execution snapshot test passed locally; the pre-existing GEN-001..004 contract tests are retained in the same module. Full release/UAT gates remain owned by the root task.
